mapper.select: SELECT card_id, LPAD(bank_code_std, 10, '0') AS institution_id, card_num_masked, card_name, card_member_type FROM mock_card_info WHERE ci = #{ci} ORDER BY card_id
SELECT card_id, card_num_masked, card_name, card_member_type FROM mock_card_info WHERE ci = #{ci} AND bank_code_std = #{bankCodeStd} ORDER BY card_id

SELECT b.charge_month, b.settlement_seq_no, b.card_id, b.charge_amt, b.settlement_day, b.settlement_date, b.credit_check_type FROM mock_card_bill b JOIN mock_card_info c ON b.card_id = c.card_id WHERE b.ci = #{ci} AND c.bank_code_std = #{bankCodeStd} AND b.charge_month BETWEEN #{fromMonth} AND #{toMonth} ORDER BY b.charge_month, b.card_id, b.settlement_seq_no
SELECT card_id, LPAD(bank_code_std, 10, '0') AS institution_id, card_num_masked AS card_num, card_name FROM mock_card_info WHERE ci = #{ci} ORDER BY card_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT CAST(settlement_seq_no AS CHAR) AS seqno, SUM(charge_amt) AS charge_amt, LPAD(settlement_day, 2, '0') AS charge_day, charge_month, settlement_date AS paid_out_date FROM mock_card_bill WHERE ci = #{ci} AND charge_month BETWEEN #{fromMonth} AND #{toMonth} GROUP BY charge_month, settlement_seq_no, settlement_day, settlement_date ORDER BY charge_month, settlement_seq_no LIMIT #{limit}
